The issuer shows significant financial stress: profitability is negative (Net income -640M; EBIT/operating income -459M) and equity is very thin relative to total assets (Shareholders’ equity 415M vs. Total assets 12,240M). While liquidity appears moderate (Current ratio ≈ 4,976/2,796 = 1.78), the combination of losses and high leverage points to a lower speculative grade credit quality.  
DECISION: B-
